name: Paul Flynn
html:
In recognition of his outstanding contributions to sustainable development and global impact.

Through visionary leadership and unwavering dedication, Paul Flynn has championed initiatives that drive meaningful change, fostering a more equitable and sustainable future for communities worldwide. His commitment to innovation and social responsibility exemplifies the values of the IASC and serves as an inspiration for future generations.

This award honors his remarkable achievements and transformative influence in advancing the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

name: Juan Naya
html:
In recognition of his exceptional leadership and transformative contributions to the healthcare and skincare industries.

As a visionary leader, Juan Naya has exemplified excellence in innovation and strategic thinking, driving ISDIN to unprecedented success. His unwavering commitment to quality, sustainability, and cutting-edge advancements has not only elevated the company to global prominence but also redefined standards in dermatological science and care.

This award honors his exemplary achievements, dedication to innovation, and enduring influence, reflecting the values of integrity, excellence, and progress upheld by the IASC.

name: Zee Wang
html:
In recognition of his transformative leadership and groundbreaking contributions to the world of financial innovation.

As the visionary behind CoinClan, Zee Wang has redefined the role of blockchain technology in fostering global inclusivity and empowerment. Under his guidance, CoinClan has become a trailblazer in advancing decentralized economies, breaking barriers to financial access, and revolutionizing how communities engage with digital finance.

This award celebrates Zee Wang’s unwavering dedication to creating a transparent and equitable financial ecosystem. His work has empowered individuals and businesses from diverse socio-economic backgrounds, enabling them to thrive in an increasingly digitalized world and restoring trust in the promise of decentralized innovation.

name: Sir Dustin Plantholt
html:
In recognition of his exceptional dedication to empowering communities, championing innovation, and amplifying lives for global betterment.

Through his visionary leadership, Lives Amplified has emerged as a beacon of hope and a transformative force, bridging societal divides and creating opportunities for the underserved. Sir Dustin Plantholt’s unwavering commitment to humanitarian values is reflected in his ability to amplify unheard voices, foster resilience, and pave the way for sustainable progress.

This award celebrates his profound contributions to advancing a brighter and more inclusive future, exemplifying the core principles of Lives Amplified: empathy, transformation, and an unyielding pursuit of a better tomorrow.

name: Irene Vantaraki
html:
In recognition of her visionary leadership and unwavering dedication to excellence in hospitality.

As the creator of the Davos Lodge, Irene Vantaraki has seamlessly integrated hospitality, sustainability, and global thought leadership. Her commitment to fostering an environment of dialogue, collaboration, and inspiration has established the Davos Lodge as a symbol of innovation and a sanctuary for changemakers across industries.

This award celebrates her role as a trailblazer, bridging diverse perspectives and championing meaningful change to shape a better future for all.

name: Dr. Summy Smart Francis
html:
In recognition of his visionary leadership and transformative contributions to entrepreneurship and sustainable development across Africa.

As the founder of Africa’s Young Entrepreneurs (A.Y.E.), Dr. Francis has been a catalyst for empowering young minds with the skills, resources, and networks essential for thriving in competitive markets. His unwavering commitment to fostering innovation and closing economic disparities has profoundly impacted countless lives, igniting a spirit of entrepreneurship across the continent.

This award celebrates his enduring dedication to harnessing African ingenuity, driving economic empowerment, and shaping a brighter, more inclusive future for the world.

name: Christopher Voss
html:
In recognition of his extraordinary contributions to the art and science of negotiation.

As the founder of the Black Swan Group and former lead FBI hostage negotiator, Christopher Voss has revolutionized high-stakes negotiation by integrating emotional intelligence and tactical empathy. His groundbreaking methods, as outlined in the acclaimed best-seller “Never Split the Difference,” have transcended the domains of business, law enforcement, and personal communication, setting a global standard for conflict resolution and relationship building.

This award celebrates his unparalleled ability to foster understanding, bridge divides, and inspire the transformative power of human connection.

name: Dr. Nasif Nadir
html:
In recognition of his extraordinary contributions to nutraceuticals, nutragenomics, and clinical biochemistry.

As a distinguished leader in his field, Dr. Nasif Nadir has been a trailblazer in advancing scientific knowledge and practical applications in health and wellness. His work has earned recognition from prestigious institutions such as the Red Cross and garnered accolades including knighthoods from the Royal Houses of Montenegro and Portugal. Dr. Nadir’s commitment to innovation and excellence continues to inspire the global scientific community.

This award celebrates his remarkable achievements in fostering a deeper understanding of the interplay between genetics, nutrition, and human health, embodying the transformative power of knowledge and collaboration.

name: Andrey Shestakov
html:
In recognition of his exceptional contributions to the world of art and cultural innovation.

As a visionary artist, Andrey Shestakov has masterfully redefined the boundaries of contemporary art, merging traditional techniques with bold modern expressions. Through his unique artistic voice, he has inspired audiences worldwide, fostering a deeper appreciation for creativity and the transformative power of visual storytelling.

This award celebrates his remarkable talent, dedication, and enduring impact on the global artistic landscape, reflecting the universal values of beauty, connection, and cultural evolution.

name: Patti Campbell
html:
In recognition of her extraordinary contributions as a life coach.

As an inspiring mentor and guide, Patti Campbell has transformed lives through her empathetic approach, profound wisdom, and unwavering dedication to personal growth. Her unique ability to empower individuals to realize their fullest potential has left a lasting impact on countless lives, fostering resilience, clarity, and fulfillment.

This award celebrates her exceptional talent, dedication, and enduring influence in the field of personal development, embodying the values of empowerment, compassion, and transformation.

name: Spencer Churchill Law
html:
In recognition of their outstanding contributions to the field of law.

As a beacon of legal excellence, Spencer Churchill Law has exemplified unwavering commitment to justice, innovation, and professionalism. Through their exceptional expertise and dedication, they have shaped the legal landscape, championing integrity and fostering trust in the legal profession.

This award celebrates their remarkable achievements, dedication to the rule of law, and profound impact on the global community, reflecting the principles of fairness, leadership, and innovation.

name: Irina Gamagina of Sotheby’s London
html:
In recognition of her exceptional contributions to the field of luxury real estate.

As a trailblazer in the industry, Irina Gamagina has consistently set new standards of excellence, blending unparalleled expertise with an innate understanding of sophistication and elegance. Her visionary approach has not only elevated Sotheby’s London to greater heights but also inspired a new generation of professionals in the luxury real estate market.

This award celebrates her remarkable achievements, dedication, and transformative influence, showcasing the values of innovation, excellence, and distinction in the global real estate arena.

name: Olen Cesari
html:
The Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation is honored to present the Medal of Honor for Distinguished Service to Society to Olen Cesari, a remarkable violinist whose artistic contributions extend far beyond the concert stage.

Olen Cesari’s musical journey is marked by extraordinary talent and a deep commitment to using his art as a vehicle for social change. Through his performances, he has inspired countless individuals and fostered a love for classical music in diverse communities. His dedication to music education has empowered young musicians, providing them with opportunities to express themselves and develop their skills.

In addition to his artistic endeavors, Cesari has actively participated in charitable initiatives, using his platform to raise awareness and support for various social causes. His passion for philanthropy exemplifies his belief in the transformative power of music to unite people and promote healing.

This award recognizes Olen Cesari’s exceptional contributions to the arts and his unwavering commitment to enhancing the fabric of society through music. His influence and legacy serve as a powerful reminder of the vital role artists play in inspiring change and fostering community.

Congratulations, Olen Cesari, on this prestigious honor, which reflects your extraordinary service to society and your profound impact on the lives of many.

name: Prof. Dr. Nikola Jankulovski
html:
The Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation is proud to recognize Prof. Dr. Nikola Jankulovski for his outstanding contributions to scientific research and his unwavering commitment to service that benefits humanity.

Prof. Dr. Jankulovski’s work has significantly advanced the frontiers of knowledge within his field, establishing him as a leader in innovative research. His studies have not only enriched academic discourse but have also translated into practical applications that address critical global challenges.

Beyond his research, Prof. Dr. Jankulovski is deeply committed to mentoring the next generation of scientists. His dedication to education and outreach fosters a culture of inquiry and civic responsibility among his students, empowering them to make a positive impact in their communities.

This award honors Prof. Dr. Jankulovski’s exceptional achievements and his holistic approach to science as a means of enhancing societal welfare. His exemplary service exemplifies the values of our institute and inspires us all to strive for excellence in both research and community engagement.

Congratulations, Prof. Dr. Nikola Jankulovski, on this well-deserved recognition of your profound impact on science and humanity.

name: H.E. Rev. Benito Adán Méndez Bracamonte
html:
It’s my privilege to honor His Excellency Rev. Benito Adán Méndez Bracamonte Ordinario militare per il Venezuela by awarding him a Certificate of Appreciation from The Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation. His life echoes the values of the World Changers Summit.

Let’s extend our gratitude and congratulations to him on this well-deserved recognition. May he continue being a guiding light for those seeking wisdom and a symbol of Christ’s love. Thank you, Bishop Méndez, for your steadfast service. God bless.

name: Rev Monsignore Dario Edoardo Viganò
html:
Rev Monsignore Dario Edoardo Viganò, your profound insight and tireless dedication have bridged the realms of faith and communication, echoing the voices of Catholics worldwide through the power of media science.

Your pioneering work, embodying both ingenuity and honor, has set new standards in media communication and engagement. Through your endeavours, the teachings of the Church and the experiences of the faithful have been shared more widely, connecting hearts and minds across our global community.

It is with great respect that we present to you the Outstanding Contribution in Media Science Award. This award is a symbol of our profound gratitude for your exceptional contribution to the Church’s communication efforts and a testament to the significant impact of your work in media science.

Rev Monsignore Viganò, your work illuminates the power of faith in the digital age, fostering dialogue and understanding in our increasingly interconnected world. We thank you for enriching our faith, connecting our global community, and elevating our understanding of the Church’s teachings through your innovative use of media science.

Let us celebrate Rev Monsignore Dario Edoardo Viganò, whose pioneering contributions will guide the Church’s communication efforts for generations to come. Thank you for harnessing the power of media to spread the love and teachings of our faith.

name: Rev. Monsignore Jean Maria Garvais
html:
Rev Monsignore Garvais, your integrity and honor mirror the Gospel’s teachings, inspiring us to foster a world filled with kindness and love. Your steadfast commitment and humble service exemplify our Catholic faith’s core principles.

With profound honor, we present to you a Certificate of Appreciation, recognizing your tireless service and embodiment of the Church’s teachings. This certificate signifies our heartfelt appreciation and deep gratitude for your unwavering commitment.

Rev Monsignore Garvais, you are a living testament of Christ’s compassion and integrity, urging us all to walk the path of empathy. Let us honor Rev Monsignore Garvais, whose faithful example continues to guide us on our journey of faith. Thank you for illuminating our path and inspiring us to follow the footsteps of our Savior.

name: Dr. Christina Rahm
html:
From her roots in a diverse cultural background, Dr. Rahm has cultivated a unique approach to health, a harmonious blend of tradition and innovation. With academic achievements from Cornell and Harvard Universities spanning diverse areas such as Nanotechnology and Nutrition, she stands as a true luminary in the world of scientific research.

As a veteran in the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and biotechnology sectors, she has left her mark at notable organizations like Johnson & Johnson, Biogen, and Bristol Meyers Squibb. Today, she serves as the Chairman of the International Science Nutrition Society and the Chief Science Officer for ROOT Wellness, while continuing to formulate innovative health solutions.

Yet, her work is not confined to laboratories and boardrooms. Having battled Lyme disease and cancer, Dr. Rahm’s personal journey to wellness has spurred her on to empower others through her consulting firm, where she promotes holistic balance.

Her book, “Cure the Causes: Live the Life you Want, Not the One Prescribed,” underscores her commitment to holistic health, capturing her wisdom and sharing it with the world.

Her dedication to empowering individuals and her passion for holistic well-being have made her an inspirational force in the field of medical science.

In recognition of her work, we are proud to present Dr. Christina Rahm with the 2023 Medical Science Innovation Award. Dr. Rahm, your dedication and innovative contributions continue to shape the future of health and wellness.

name: Robert Grant
html:
Robert Grant, a visionary, a pioneer, a disruptor, has proven to be an exceptional figure in the face of the daunting challenge posed by quantum computing. His contribution to quantum-secure encryption is unparalleled and has set the course for others to follow.

Robert’s visionary approach has illuminated our understanding of encryption in a new light. His company Crown Sterling has successfully tackled the vulnerabilities of conventional encryption systems, by ingeniously employing irrational numbers and machine learning algorithms. Their work with One-Time Pad encryption, the only mathematically proven, unconditionally secure symmetric encryption algorithm, demonstrates their commitment to impenetrable security.

Tonight, we are not just honoring a leader but a revolutionary mind that constantly pushes the envelope. Robert’s dedication to secure our digital future is truly inspiring.

Ladies and Gentlemen, it is with immense pleasure and admiration that I present The Quantum Security Award to Mr. Robert Grant. Robert, thank you for safeguarding our digital lives. Your groundbreaking work continues to challenge, inspire, and lead us towards a safer, more secure future.

Please join me in extending a warm and heartfelt congratulations to Robert Grant, our esteemed Quantum Security Awardee.

name: Lina Kay
html:
Born into a diverse Lebanese-French-Italian heritage, Lina navigated a global journey from Lebanon to the UK due to civil unrest. This globally-minded scholar holds a law degree, a Ph.D. in Philosophy, and is multilingual. Her commitment to peace is evident in her role as an Ambassador for Peace and a judge for the British Foreign Association.

Lina’s influential TV talk show has earned her a place among the world’s most influential women. Her authenticity resonates with audiences, making her programs a success on social media and TV.

A committed peace activist, Lina penned a peace song, “We Can Live Together,” in 2006. Her work for peace was recognized in 2016, when she was invited to meet Queen Elizabeth II at the Royal Garden Party.

Innovation is a hallmark of Lina’s career, shown by her creation of Visual Radio, integrating radio with robotic cameras and social media. She continues this innovative spirit, currently developing a 3D animation project to educate children about peace and animal cruelty.

Based in the UK, Lina operates her peace project, Hala London Radio and Television. A champion for balance and harmony, Lina is also a certified Reiki practitioner who devotes time to helping animals.

As we present Lina Kay with the Media Bright Star Award tonight, we celebrate her invaluable contributions to media, peace, and animal advocacy. Lina, your words inspire us all: “We have to live in harmony in order to protect the planet.”

name: Patrizia Marin
html:
As the chairman of Marco Polo Experience, Patrizia’s leadership and expertise have driven the success of this top-tier agency for over two decades. Her impact on international business strategies, communication campaigns, and media relations is truly outstanding.

Patrizia’s illustrious career includes advising the Italian Presidency of the Council of Ministers for Communication, Publishing, and Information, and leading communications for several prominent infrastructure institutions. She leverages her law and International Political Science degree to shape future leaders as a Contract Professor at IULM University of Milan.

In presenting her with the Media Strategist Award, we celebrate not just Patrizia’s impressive career, but her enduring influence on strategic communication. Please join me in honoring Patrizia Marin, a true leader in her field.

name: Rowena Gates
html:
Now we celebrate Rowena Gates, an innovator and seasoned entrepreneur at Eng3 Corporation, instrumental in launching the transformative NanoVi technology. A champion of collaboration, Rowena’s groundbreaking Ph.D. work at the University of Washington set the foundation for her impressive entrepreneurial career.

Prior to Eng3, she founded Aviarc Corporation and co-founded a company that merged into ImageSource, establishing her as a leader in the high-tech industry. Since 2005, Rowena has focused on improving individual health and wellness, guiding the development of the NanoVi device, which has been verified to improve cellular health.

As we present this certificate of appreciation, we acknowledge Rowena Gates’ invaluable contributions to business and health sectors, embodying the power of innovation and a resilient entrepreneurial spirit. Let’s join together to honor her.

name: Victoria Kennedy
html:
Next, we honor Victoria Kennedy, known as “The Lightkeeper,” a Wall Street Journal Best-Selling Author, TEDx speaker, and CEO of Victorious PR. We present her with the Cultural Social Impact Award, celebrating her broad influence.

Victoria’s exceptional skills in public relations have amplified global leaders’ voices, earning respect from organizations like Forbes and Yahoo! Finance. Beyond corporate success, she’s a globally recognized classical singer, her music reaching the apex of the iTunes Classical Charts.

Managing a thriving PR agency, she’s also a guiding light for entrepreneurs, executives, and leading companies. Her insights have featured in over 200 publications and podcasts worldwide.

As we present this award, we celebrate not just Victoria’s achievements but also her commitment to highlighting others’ remarkable stories. Please join me in honoring Victoria Kennedy, a shining example of leadership, embodying true cultural social impact.

name: Dr. Artur Koziol
html:
Dr. Artur Koziol, the dedicated Mayor of Wieliczka, Poland. His leadership of 17 years in Wieliczka, home of the iconic Salt Mine, demonstrates his unyielding commitment to local communities and sustainable development.

Dr. Kozio?’s expertise in local services management has positively influenced not only Wieliczka but also numerous communities worldwide, as he’s actively involved in organizing international scientific conferences on sustainability.

His outstanding contributions have earned him significant recognition, such as the Pontifical Order of Saint Sylvester, conferred by Pope Francis for co-organizing the World Youth Day 2016. His unrelenting support for Ukrainian refugees, exemplified in establishing an Aid Center for Ukraine in Grabie, won him “The Cross of Freedom”.

Today, it is our privilege to present him with the Outstanding Humanitarian Effort Award, honoring his exemplary service, dedication to sustainable development, and unwavering pursuit of social justice. Let us commend Dr. Artur Koziol for his inspiring actions and enduring impact on communities globally.

name: Prof. Giuseppe Tedeschi
html:
Prof. Daniele Tedeschi, the Scientific Director of Genobioma.

With an illustrious background in various disciplines, including neurology, pharmacology, reproductive medicine, endocrinology, oncology, and cardiovascular diseases, Dr. Tedeschi’s contributions to the scientific community have been transformative. His decision, over a decade ago, to focus on the reading of the entire DNA rather than just a few genes, marked a significant shift in our approach to understanding genetic risk factors.

The founder of Genobioma, an Italian company at the forefront of genetic polymorphism studies, Dr. Tedeschi has championed the development of precision medicine models. His innovative approach to the integration of bioinformatics, pharmacogenomics, and nutrigenomics has significantly impacted advanced medicine and the way we treat illnesses today.

Currently, Dr. Tedeschi leads the way in applying predictive medicine and pharmacogenomics, especially in cardiovascular diseases, neurodegenerative disorders, and immunity-related illnesses. His work helps millions navigate the delicate balance between life and health.

In recognition of his groundbreaking contributions and unwavering devotion to the arts of science, we are proud to present Dr. Daniele Tedeschi with the Devotion and Contribution to the Arts Award today. His inspiring work continues to revolutionize our understanding of the human body and our ability to predict and combat diseases. Dr. Tedeschi, we celebrate you and your exceptional contribution to biological science.

name: HeirStory
html:
And the final award of the evening is bestowed upon a transformative venture, HeirStory, and its founder, a man whom I have the privilege of calling both a dear friend and a brother at heart, Dustin Plantholt.

HeirStory, under Dustin’s visionary stewardship, elegantly combines AI, blockchain technology, and philanthropy. Its essence lies in preserving personal narratives, bolstering data security, and enabling positive impact through charitable giving. By harnessing these advanced technologies, HeirStory provides a platform to immortalize our stories, to bequeath a digital legacy for future generations, all while making a meaningful difference to causes that matter.

Dustin, widely recognized as the “Count of Monte Crypto,” is the embodiment of relentless innovation and commitment. His journey, adorned with accolades including Entrepreneur.com’s Metaverse Advisor of the Year and features on Forbes Monaco’s 40 under 40 list, attests to his unfaltering commitment to enhancing the world.

As a dear friend, I’ve had the unique privilege of witnessing Dustin’s unwavering determination, his visionary thinking, and his steadfast commitment to philanthropy. His work with HeirStory is an affirmation of his belief in the transformative power of storytelling and the potential of technology to effect meaningful change.

With immense honor and personal pride, I am thrilled to present HeirStory with the 2023 Social Impact Startup of the Year Award. Dustin, as you accept this award on behalf of HeirStory, we applaud your inspirational innovation, your visionary perspective, and your commitment to leveraging technology for the greater good.

Yet, our recognition does not stop there. As the founder of the Institute for Advanced Studies and Cooperation, I am equally thrilled to announce that we are presenting you with a grant from our foundation in the amount of $2,500 USD. We are confident that this contribution will further support your extraordinary efforts with HeirStory.

May your journey with HeirStory continue to inspire, revolutionize, and make a lasting, positive impact. Your work, Dustin, is a testament to your resilience and ambition. I am confident that HeirStory will continue to push boundaries and set new standards in the years to come.

Congratulations, my dear friend, my brother Sir. Dustin Plantholt.

Keep changing the world, one story at a time.
